description: Comparison of the three convergent oxygen-independent isomerase solutions (FabA, FabM, FabN), their folds, branch-point positions, and partner condensing enzymes
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 7.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 13); ax.set_ylim(0, 9); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(6.5, 8.5, "Convergent solutions to oxygen-independent cis double-bond introduction",
        ha='center', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(6.5, 8.05, "Same product (cis-3-decenoyl-ACP), three non-orthologous enzymes, two branch-point positions",
        ha='center', fontsize=10, style='italic', color='#444')

# shared substrate line at top
def box(x, y, w, h, text, fc, fs=8.5, bold=False, tc='black'):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.04,rounding_size=0.1",
                 linewidth=1.2, edgecolor='#333', facecolor=fc))
    ax.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
            fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal', color=tc)

def arr(x1,y1,x2,y2,label='',c='#333'):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle='-|>',mutation_scale=14,lw=1.8,color=c))
    if label: ax.text((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2+0.18,label,ha='center',fontsize=7.5,color=c,fontweight='bold')

# common start
box(5.2, 7.0, 2.6, 0.7, "(3R)-3-hydroxydecanoyl-ACP", '#cfe2f3', bold=True)

# E. coli / FabA route (left)
arr(5.2, 7.35, 3.0, 6.6, 'FabA dehydratase', '#b45f06')
box(1.6, 5.9, 2.9, 0.7, "trans-2-decenoyl-ACP", '#ffe599', bold=True)
arr(3.05, 5.9, 3.05, 5.0, 'FabA isomerase', '#b45f06')
box(1.6, 4.3, 2.9, 0.7, "cis-3-decenoyl-ACP", '#f9cb9c', bold=True)
ax.text(3.05, 3.95, "branch point A: after 3-OH-C10", ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#b45f06')

# FabM route (middle): shared dehydratase FabZ makes trans-2, then FabM isomerizes
arr(6.5, 7.0, 6.5, 6.6, 'FabZ (general dehydratase)', '#3d85c6')
box(5.05, 5.9, 2.9, 0.7, "trans-2-decenoyl-ACP", '#ffe599', bold=True)
arr(6.5, 5.9, 6.5, 5.0, 'FabM isomerase (crotonase fold)', '#38761d')
box(5.05, 4.3, 2.9, 0.7, "cis-3-decenoyl-ACP", '#f9cb9c', bold=True)
ax.text(6.5, 3.95, "branch point B: after trans-2-C10", ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#38761d')

# FabN route (right)
arr(7.8, 7.35, 10.0, 6.6, 'FabN dehydratase', '#674ea7')
box(8.6, 5.9, 2.9, 0.7, "trans-2-decenoyl-ACP", '#ffe599', bold=True)
arr(10.05, 5.9, 10.05, 5.0, 'FabN isomerase (FabZ fold)', '#674ea7')
box(8.6, 4.3, 2.9, 0.7, "cis-3-decenoyl-ACP", '#f9cb9c', bold=True)
ax.text(10.05, 3.95, "branch point A", ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#674ea7')

# converge to commitment
box(4.6, 2.7, 3.8, 0.7, "committed by condensing enzyme\n(FabB / FabF-type)  + malonyl-ACP", '#d9ead3', bold=True)
for x in [3.05, 6.5, 10.05]:
    arr(x, 4.3, min(max(x,5.6),7.4), 3.4, c='#999')

# comparison table
tbl_y = 1.9
ax.text(0.3, tbl_y+0.35, "Feature", fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')
cols = [("FabA (E. coli)", '#b45f06', 3.6), ("FabM (S. pneumoniae)", '#38761d', 6.9), ("FabN (E. faecalis)", '#674ea7', 10.2)]
for name,c,x in cols:
    ax.text(x, tbl_y+0.35, name, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=c, ha='center')
rows = [
 ("Fold", ["hot-dog", "crotonase", "hot-dog (FabZ)"]),
 ("Dehydratase activity", ["yes (bifunctional)", "no", "yes (bifunctional)"]),
 ("Orthologous to FabA?", ["—", "no", "no (FabZ family)"]),
 ("Typical partner synthase", ["FabB (KAS I)", "FabF/FabO-type", "FabF/FabO-type"]),
]
for i,(feat,vals) in enumerate(rows):
    y = tbl_y - 0.05 - i*0.42
    ax.text(0.3, y, feat, fontsize=8)
    for (name,c,x),v in zip(cols, vals):
        ax.text(x, y, v, fontsize=8, ha='center')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('convergent_isomerases_comparison.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Saved convergent isomerase comparison figure.")
